weeks.title: English Foundations and Basic Sentence Formation
weeks.description: Master essential sentence structures (SVO), subject-verb agreement, common auxiliary verbs, and foundational conversational patterns with zero confusion.
learningObjectives: Auxiliary Verbs (Be, Do, Have) in Present Simple

weeks.title: Grammar and Tenses Mastery
weeks.description: Gain complete control over past, present, and future tenses. Learn how native speakers convey timelines, continuous actions, and completed experiences naturally.
learningObjectives: Present Simple vs. Present Continuous in Real Contexts
Past Simple vs. Present Perfect: Eliminating Common Errors
Future Projections (Will vs. Going to vs. Present Continuous)
Time Markers, Prepositions of Time (In, On, At) & Practice Drills

weeks.title: Vocabulary and Everyday Expressions
weeks.description: Expand beyond basic vocabulary with 250+ high-frequency collocations, phrasal verbs, idioms, and natural transitions used in daily interactions.
learningObjectives: High-Frequency Phrasal Verbs for Everyday Life
Expressing Opinions, Agreement, and Polite Disagreement
Idiomatic Expressions for Modern Social Conversation

weeks.title: Spoken English and Conversation Practice
weeks.description: Develop spoken fluency, overcome hesitation, and practice real-time conversational turn-taking, active listening cues, and storytelling techniques.
learningObjectives: Overcoming Hesitation & Fear of Making Mistakes
Asking Engaging Open-Ended Questions in Dialogue

weeks.title: Pronunciation, Accent Clarity and Listening Skills
weeks.description: Sharpen your acoustic comprehension and speech clarity. Master vowel distinctions, syllable stress, connected speech, and native intonation rhythms.
learningObjectives: Word Stress, Syllable Timing & Sentence Intonation
Listening Strategies for Fast-Paced Native Audio

weeks.title: Reading Comprehension and Writing Precision
weeks.description: Analyze diverse texts, build analytical comprehension, and draft clear, cohesive emails, professional letters, and personal essays.
learningObjectives: Skimming & Scanning Techniques for Articles & Books

weeks.title: Communication Skills and Real-Life Situations
weeks.description: Apply your English in workplace environments, job interviews, customer service, telephone calls, travel scenarios, and negotiations.

weeks.title: Revision, Practical Exercises, and Final Assessment
weeks.description: Consolidate your 8-week knowledge with practical roleplays, comprehensive grammar & vocabulary review, and your final spoken English evaluation.
learningObjectives: Final Spoken Evaluation & Course Completion Award

reviews.feedback: The 8-week structured English lessons gave me the confidence I was missing. Breaking down grammar tenses helped me speak fluently in my meetings.
I used to hesitate and translate every word in my head. The pronunciation drills in Week 5 and the real-life communication scenarios completely transformed my speaking rhythm. Highly recommended!
The weekly PDF workbooks are clear, practical, and filled with exercises that you can actually use every day. Having direct WhatsApp feedback from the instructor kept me motivated throughout.
